summary.text: Sheree Sample-Hughes is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 37A who was first elected in 2014 and has served since 2015, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Wicomico County councilwoman and Speaker Pro Tem of the House from 2019 to 2024, she serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sheree Sample-Hughes was born on September 13, 1977, and earned a B.A. in public relations from Delaware State University in 1999 and an M.S. in management and public administration from Wilmington University in 2014, according to her General Assembly biography.
She served on the Wicomico County Council from 2006 to 2014 and taught as a student development instructor at Wor-Wic Community College in 2014.

Sample-Hughes served on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2015 to 2023, the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee from 2020 to 2024, and the Judiciary Committee from 2024 to 2025.
She was Speaker Pro Tem from 2019 to 2024 and was president of Women Legislators of Maryland in 2018 to 2019.
In 2026 she chairs the Alcoholic Beverages Subcommittee of the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee, and Ballotpedia reports that she advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
